apropos.title: Zanka Gwarzey Dumi Sahel Ra.
apropos.description: OPE Agadez ti anniya beeri kaŋ ga Nijer zanka carmey beerandi nda i goyey ceeci. Ir ga tammahaŋ kaŋ teerey beerey ga fatta ir al'aada nda hiino tekinoloji margeyaŋ ra.
apropos.pilier_1_desc: Dondonandi beeri zankey se kaŋ ga sohõ nda suba tekinoloji gaabey hanse.
apropos.pilier_2_desc: Ir ga miiley canse ka ciya goyey cimi. Jinayey, jine-dirawey nda gaakasinay doona teeyaŋ ra, ir ga zanka kokoroyey gina.
apropos.pilier_3_desc: Zanka gwarzey marge nda carmey beerey zankey kaŋ ga hiino goyey cimi.
apropos.inspiration_quote: Hamada man ti koonu nango, laakal nda bine-gaabu nango no.
apropos.timeline_subtitle: Bay fondo beerey kaŋ OPE Agadez dira za šintino hala sohõ.

form.subtitle: Kani takardoo wo ka huru Fuwo 3 fondi ra.
form.step1_desc: Suuba dumi beero war huruyaŋ se.

form.step4_desc: Fahamandi war goyey wala war anniya House wo kuna
form.step4_status_label: Ifo no war goyoo sohõ haŋ ? *
form.step4_project_label: Alhabar war goyoo, war tunandi wala war bine gaaboo *
form.step4_placeholder_steam: Alhabar bayray nda tekinoloji gaaboo kaŋ war ga ba hanse, jinayey kaŋ war ga ba goy (code, mekaniki, lantarki) nda war anniyey...
form.step4_placeholder_lp: Alhabar war kwaara goyoo: fari/alman/kambe goy dumi, albarka wanjiroo, baŋkoy nda hiino cinyaŋ...
form.step4_placeholder_mcc: Alhabar kwaara goyoo kaŋ war te wala war ga ba te: kwaara albarkoo, borey taaroo, laafiya nda baani iragaw...
form.step4_recommandant_label: Cee fondi jine-diray wala boro bay nda war se ga marawandi (Maa & Telifon)
form.step4_citoyen_recommandant: Boro kaŋ war laabi alwaaloo ga tabbatandi maa nda cee
form.step5_desc: Har ir se ifo no ga war bine gaabi ka huru Agadez 2026 ra.
form.step5_motivation_label: Ifo ya war ga ba huru CNCEIZ ra? Ifo war ga ba di ka koy war kwaara ra bayan sansanoo? *
form.step5_motivation_placeholder: Har ir se ifo no ga war gindi, ifo war ga ba bay gwarzo 1000 banda nda yadda war ga naŋey ndi war yanki ra...
form.step5_numerique_label: War ga sansanoo ra telifon wala tablet ganda ? *
form.step5_num_place: Bia, amma ay ga soola nango ra
form.step6_desc: Takarda dumey kaŋ ga huru : PDF, JPG, PNG (Kada ma bisa 5 MB).

form.step6_preuve_hint: Jinay biya, attestation, alhabar wala widiyoo

form.step7_cert: Ay ga tabbatandi alhabar kulu kaŋ ay hantumandi wannoo foom ra no cimi.
form.step7_cert_desc: Wannoo akwatin cibi ra, ay ga rantumandi ay dunka alhabar kulu cimey se kaŋ ay noo hantum nda ay soolandi kulu sansanin yankey nda Agadez sansanoo beero ra Desaambar 2026 ra.
form.step7_cert_parent: Ay ga tabbatandi baaba/jine-koy maatoo ra ay ga wannoo huruyaŋ takarda bisa nda baani.
form.step7_cert_parent_desc: Wannoo akwatin cibi ra, baaba wala jine-koy ga hurukoy jinkollo se izini do shiga porogaramoo ra nda alhabar kulu cimey tabbatoo.
